en.title: Phantom Blade Zero Smashes 4 Million Sales in Just 72 Hours
en.summary: S-Game's wuxia-inspired action title, **Phantom Blade Zero**, has achieved an explosive launch, selling an incredible 4 million copies within its first three days. The game's stunning success has seen it dominate sales charts and captivate a massive global audience.
en.body:
The gaming world is still reeling from the sheer velocity of **Phantom Blade Zero**'s launch. Developer S-Game has officially announced that its highly anticipated wuxia-themed action game has sold a staggering 4 million copies across PlayStation 5 and PC platforms in just 72 hours. This remarkable achievement underscores the immense anticipation surrounding the title and its immediate impact on the market.

The official X (formerly Twitter) account for **Phantom Blade Zero** shared the news with a heartfelt message: “Thank you everyone from the bottom of our hearts for all the love and support!” The game's early performance was so strong that it immediately topped Steam charts, outpacing even established giants like **PUBG** and **Dota 2** in concurrent players. It also secured the top spot for revenue on Steam, surpassing major releases like **Modern Warfare 4** and **Aion 2**.

This explosive start shouldn't entirely surprise veteran players. Prior to its official release, **Phantom Blade Zero** had already garnered significant attention, with estimates suggesting over 1 million pre-launch sales across Steam, PS5, and Tencent's WeGame platform. A significant portion of these early sales, nearly two-thirds, originated from China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, pointing to a strong regional foundation for the game's success.

## A Wuxia Spectacle Captivates Players

The overwhelming player response is a testament to S-Game's vision and execution. Critics have lauded the game's fluid combat and striking visuals, with IGN awarding it a 9/10 and praising its "unbelievably smooth action game filled with memorable boss fights, compelling combat, and limitless swagger." The game's appeal extends beyond its core mechanics, featuring a star-studded cast that includes Roger Craig Smith, known for voicing iconic characters like Ezio Auditore and Batman, and Maggie Robertson, who famously portrayed Lady Dimitrescu in **Resident Evil Village**. Donnie Yen also contributed as a key creative consultant and voice actor.

## Community Roars Its Approval

Fans have eagerly embraced **Phantom Blade Zero**, flooding social media with praise for its intricate combat, stunning art direction, and authentic wuxia atmosphere. The game's ability to deliver on its ambitious promises has clearly resonated with a global audience hungry for fresh, high-quality action experiences. While the sales are monumental, it's worth noting that **Black Myth: Wukong**, another highly anticipated wuxia title, achieved 10 million sales in its first three days, setting an incredibly high bar for the genre.

## What's Next

With such an explosive debut, all eyes are now on S-Game and **Phantom Blade Zero**'s continued trajectory. Further sales milestones and potential post-launch content updates are highly anticipated by the burgeoning player base.

content_raw: Phantom Blade Zero is officially the next big thing. Developer S-Game has announced that its wuxia-themed action game has surpassed a significant milestone in just a few days. Within 72 hours of going on sale, Phantom Blade Zero has sold 4 million copies. The official X / Twitter account posted the news with a message: “Thank you everyone from the bottom of our hearts for all the love and support!” Even on its first day, it was clear this was going to be a beast. Phantom Blade Zero was ahead of Steam’s biggest games , from PUBG to Dota 2, topping the Steam charts as soon as it launched. It was also the best-selling game on Steam by revenue, ahead of Modern Warfare 4, Aion 2, and Probably Stolen, a Cyberpunk shopkeeper sim that's going viral. Steam concurrents peaked on Sunday with a whopping 833,921 players. The early success shouldn't come as a huge surprise. Last week, it was estimated that Phantom Blade Zero had sold over 1 million copies before launch across launch platforms Steam and PS5, and Tencent’s WeGame (an online PC storefront in China). Nearly two thirds of total prelaunch sales were from China, Taiwan, or Hong Kong. IGN's Phantom Blade Zero review returned a 9/10. We said: "Phantom Blade Zero is an unbelievably smooth action game filled with memorable boss fights, compelling combat, and limitless swagger." Phantom Blade Zero is a monster hit, but it's not quite on par with Black Myth: Wukong, which managed 10 million sales in the first three days . Roger Craig Smith — best known as Sonic the Hedgehog, Ezio Auditore, Batman, and Chris Redfield — plays the lead character. The actor is joined by Mu Xiaokui actor Maggie Robertson, who played Lady Dimitrescu in Resident Evil 7. Elsewhere in the cast, Donnie Yen served as a key creative consultant and stars as the character Mó Yuan (Soul's father) through full facial, voice, and motion capture. Before you step into the Phantom World, we’ve put together a helpful list of Things Phantom Blade Zero Doesn’t Tell You . We’ve also got a step-by-step Phantom Blade Zero Walkthrough in progress, plus guides for the game’s Weapons , Accessories , and Phantom Edges .
